evidence.description: On a query failure, if the client-supplied 'report_mode' query param equals 'full', the error message, stack trace, and active filters are returned to the client instead of a generic message.
CORS misconfiguration (CWE-942) at app/routes/compensation.tsx:192-199. Verified by manual review of the pinned commit.
Logs the entire compensation-request formData (salary, bonus, notes) verbatim to the activity trail whenever validation fails.

Manager or HR admin can attach a reviewer note to ANY compensation record by recordId; no check that the record belongs to one of the manager's direct reports (only role check happens at the top of action()).

An uploaded JSON 'profile draft' file is JSON.parse'd and spread directly into the ORM update with no field allowlist, letting any key in the document (managerId, isSensitiveInfoReviewed, taxId, etc.) overwrite arbitrary employee columns.

HR employee export writes a CSV to var/compliance-archive/<label>.csv where label comes verbatim from the x-archive-label request header; no basename/sanitization, so '../../' segments write outside the archive dir.
Builds a shell command string embedding the user-supplied exportFormat and spawns it with shell:true, allowing command injection via the format parameter.

AES-256-CBC decryption of the onboarding wizard resume token distinguishes bad-padding failures from other failures and surfaces that distinction to the HTTP response, enabling a padding-oracle attack.
Fetches an arbitrary URL taken directly from the x-policy-source-url request header with no host validation, enabling SSRF.
Writes an uploaded employee portrait file to public/avatars using the original filename with no MIME/size validation, in a web-accessible directory.
After closing an HR request, the handler redirects to the caller-supplied X-Return-To header value with no validation, enabling open redirect.
HR admin's raw corporate-directory search term (from ?name= query param) is interpolated unsanitized into an activityLogger.info() call, allowing CRLF/log-line injection.
Hardcoded credential (CWE-798) at app/utils/db.server.ts:15. Verified by manual review of the pinned commit.
Hashes the shared time-clock kiosk PIN with bcrypt using a client-supplied confirmationPasses value (rounds), allowing a caller to request a weak cost factor.
When a compensation record is marked effective, the payroll provider API key is sent in the query string of a plain-http GET request.
Hardcoded cryptographic key (CWE-321) at app/utils/session.server.ts:3. Verified by manual review of the pinned commit.
